title: Unit determinant makes a square free sheaf map invertible
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], I a finite index type with decidable equality, and f an endomorphism of the free structure-sheaf module on I [def-weil-pbc-free-module, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. If the determinant of its global matrix [def-weil-matrix, def-weil-pbc-matrix-determinant] is a unit, then f is an isomorphism. The index type may be empty and X need not be affine.

proof.text: Evaluation at the terminal open identifies compatible sections with global sections: the inverse restricts a global section to every open. Compose this identification with SheafOfModules.freeHomEquiv to identify maps from a free sheaf with families of global sections. Compose with freeSectionsEquiv to identify their columns with matrices. This proves injectivity of freeMatrix and constructs a sheaf map from any prescribed matrix.

Using freeSectionsEquiv_app, calculate freeMatrix(p followed by q)=freeMatrix(q)*freeMatrix(p). The identity matrix calculation is freeπ_app_ιFree_app. Let B=(freeMatrix f) inverse, the nonsingular inverse constructed by the adjugate divided by the unit determinant. Assemble its columns into g using the above equivalence. Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul and Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv give the two inverse equalities; matrix injectivity transports these to sheaf maps, providing IsIso f. All constructions and identities also hold for the empty index type.
